verdict.rationale: Codex ships its own `$skill-installer` skill, which installs curated skills by name or from a GitHub URL from inside Codex, and an agent can invoke skills. Codex also auto-discovers skill folders under `.agents/skills`, so an installed folder is picked up without manual registration. However, nothing documents that this path runs headlessly without prompts or approvals, and plugin install goes through the interactive `/plugins` browser and needs a new session. The keyless `npx skills add ... -y` probe used third-party tooling, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/no-prompt install flag or headless mode for `$skill-installer` or plugin install, a first-party CLI install command for skills/plugins, and hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven end-to-end install with Codex's own tooling.
